mapper.select: SELECT * FROM bbs_post WHERE bbs_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY is_notice DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bbs_post WHERE bbs_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bbs_post WHERE bbs_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND search_vector @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', #{keyword})
SELECT * FROM bbs_post WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs_post (bbs_id, title, content_html, content_text, author_id, author_name, is_notice, notice_from, notice_until, is_secret, status) VALUES (#{bbsId}, #{title}, #{contentHtml}, #{contentText}, #{authorId}, #{authorName}, #{isNotice}, #{noticeFrom}, #{noticeUntil}, #{isSecret}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE bbs_post SET title = #{title}, content_html = #{contentHtml}, content_text = #{contentText}, is_notice = #{isNotice}, notice_from = #{noticeFrom}, notice_until = #{noticeUntil}, is_secret = #{isSecret}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE bbs_post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bbs_post SET deleted_at = NOW(), status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
